tasks.short: Evaluate environmental-science student work and record grades

steps.what: Read actual student class, laboratory, assignment or paper submissions; verify student identifiers, assessment criteria and registry mapping
inputs: Existing assessment criteria and student registry records
outputs: Verified submissions, identifiers and explicit grade-transfer mapping to the student-information system

steps.what: Check only literal submission-format requirements such as required sections and citation formatting against explicit configured rules
inputs: Actual submissions and explicit criteria verified in s1
outputs: Format observations without scores or misconduct allegations

steps.what: Actually evaluate and grade the student's environmental-science work against original criteria and evidence; determine and enter the final human grade
inputs: Assessment criteria and literal format observations
outputs: Actual final examiner-determined grade and feedback findings

steps.what: Write and check actual feedback and the grading record using native reuse of exact submission and criterion references
inputs: Actual examiner findings and final grade
outputs: Completed checked grading and feedback record

steps.what: Save the actual feedback and grading record in its existing LMS workspace
Transfer the exact final examiner-determined grade from the LMS into the mapped student-information registry record
inputs: Verified mapping and actual completed grading record
outputs: Actual registry grade transfer result or a stopped exception

tasks.design: Use literal format checks and exact reference reuse in {LMS}, retaining the examiner's actual assessment of original student work. Transfer the exact final human grade to the student-information system, {OTHER}, only under that completed examiner decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Literal submission checks, reference entry and grade re-entry consume effort around actual assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured format rules and exact LMS-to-registry transfer can handle these operations without evaluating learning outcomes.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific reasoning, laboratory interpretation and fair grading require actual examiner judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what the student's own work demonstrates and explain the actual feedback.

ambition.what: No automatic assessment or increased assessment load is assumed.

reach.task: Resolve actual identifier or transfer exceptions
reach.learn: Which examiner-determined grade and assessment record the transfer represents

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to verify actual assessment authority, student access and registry workflow

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: literal format checks and exact grade transfer can reduce administrative repetition while actual student evaluation and grade decisions remain human.

assumptions: Representative actual assessment with required registry re-entry. Students produce original submissions and the institution existing criteria and identifiers in ordinary work. Focal submission reading, rule verification and mapping are fully counted in s1; no clean assessment feed is assumed.

s2 performs only explicit format checks, not semantic marking, cheating detection or a grade recommendation. Missing criteria or unparseable work returns to manual checking. Use existing LMS functions first; already native checks yield no new gain.

s3 is the real examiner decision on student work, not approval of the examiner's authored record. a1 refers to the exact completed grade. Any grade, assessment or identifier change in s4-s5 invalidates it and requires returning to actual assessment in s3 before s6.

s4 separately counts real feedback writing and all checking; only exact references are reused. Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. The cross-system registry write is separately gated and only runs where actual examiner authority includes that transfer; otherwise stop for the real institutional route.

Use native grade sync first; already native transfers yield no additional gain. Missing identifiers, failed writes or mismatches stop for actual manual correction. If real release requires another existing authority or notice, add that actual role, final-version decision and separate action before estimating the workflow.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 10+14*0.20+10=22.8; upkeep 4 leaves net 18.8. Retained s1,s3,s4 labour is 76.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual registry re-entry requirement and native sync
research_questions: Trace one real assessment from original student work to the LMS record and actual student registry transfer.

already_counted.description: Submission and mapping verification, actual examiner assessment and feedback writing and checking remain in s1,s3,s4.

incremental.description: Maintain literal rules and grade mappings beyond existing assessment checks.

approvals.approved_version: The exact final human grade and student-assessment identifier determined in s3; any later grade or identifier change requires a fresh actual examiner decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs manual format checks, reference copying and registry re-entry. If native registry sync already handles s6, eligible gross is 12.8; 4 upkeep leaves 8.8. Already native format checks require a lower estimate. Actual assessment remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual course requirements and source material; verify and capture timetable fields, outcomes and exact environmental-science references
outputs: Checked course inputs and exact field mapping

steps.what: Design the actual syllabus, homework tasks and handouts to match learning outcomes, student level and scientific evidence
outputs: Human learning design, task specifications and source selections

steps.what: Fill exact timetable, course, outcome and source-reference fields into the course-material draft
inputs: Verified field mapping and human learning design
outputs: Course-material draft with exact fields and missing values marked

steps.what: Write the syllabus explanations, homework wording and handout prose; check and revise drafts against the actual learning design
inputs: Human learning design and original sources

loop.purpose: Draft wording for actual teacher-designed environmental-science material
loop.input: Human task specifications, checked sources and course structure
loop.output: Draft explanations and assignment wording with source links
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific claims, student level, answerability and consistency with actual intended learning
loop.stop: Unsupported or unanswerable content is removed; two failed revisions return writing to the teacher
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates and fields handle exact content; project-specific explanations and task wording require semantic drafting

steps.what: Check the complete course materials against original sources, actual course requirements and intended student tasks
Save the completed draft in the existing private preparation workspace

tasks.design: Populate exact course fields from {LMS} into {DOCS}, then draft prose only from the teacher's actual learning design and checked scientific sources. The teacher checks the complete materials and saves the preparation draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed course fields and original explanatory prose are repeatedly assembled during real material preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field fill and source-bounded drafting can assist assembly without choosing educational content.
tasks.still_hard: Learning design, scientific accuracy and answerable assignments require the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: Choose material and questions appropriate to actual students and intended learning.

ambition.what: Prepare an additional relevant environmental-science example when actual evidence supports it.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect course and source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact course-field assembly and source-bounded prose drafting can assist material preparation while learning design and scientific checking remain human.

assumptions: Representative actual preparation episode, not setup charged to every lesson. Course administrators produce actual course requirements and source authors original scientific material during ordinary work. Focal verification and field capture are fully counted in s1; actual learning and task design in s2.

s1-s2 produce every field, scientific claim and task specification used by s3-s4. Missing evidence remains marked for actual manual investigation. No free clean teaching pack or generated scientific reference is assumed.

Use native course templates first. Existing fields give no new gain. s4 includes checking and revisions; s5 retains complete material checking. No student evaluation or scientific interpretation is delegated to a model.

Preparation is distinct from publishing materials, releasing an assessment or sending a student notice. Actual release requires its real final-version authority and a distinct action if included; no publish or send is hidden in the private save. No author self-approval is introduced.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15+25*0.40=25; upkeep 4 leaves net 21. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour totals 74 already counted. Ordinary save is minimum integer share 1 for negligible effort, fully retained, ungated and carries no saving.
unknowns: Actual preparation frequency and release workflow
research_questions: Inspect one actual material-preparation episode and distinguish learning design, exact assembly, prose revision and release.

already_counted.description: Source capture, actual learning design, prose review and full material checking remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain course-field mappings and drafting checks beyond existing preparation checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs observed fixed-field assembly and 40% less prose work after review. If native templates already handle s3, only 10 prose points remain eligible; 4 upkeep leaves 6. Repeat lessons without preparation need their own estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise environmental-science laboratory and field work

steps.what: Read actual student work instructions, site or laboratory conditions and relevant supervision records using native course filters
inputs: Actual work instructions and existing student records

steps.what: Supervise actual students' environmental-science laboratory and field work, observe practice and respond to real conditions
inputs: Actual students, laboratory or field site
outputs: Actual observed student practice and supervision

steps.what: Give actual live corrective guidance and feedback in response to observed student work
inputs: Actual observed student work and needs

steps.what: Write and check the actual required supervision observation entry from practice that has occurred
inputs: Actual observed practice and delivered guidance

steps.what: Save the actual supervision entry in its existing LMS workspace

tasks.design: Use native course filters in {LMS} and actual instructions in {DOCS}. Keep direct observation, supervision and feedback fully human, then separately write any actual required supervision entry after practice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant instructions and student context are repeatedly located before supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course views can reduce navigation without evaluating student practice.
tasks.still_hard: Real laboratory and field conditions and student needs require attentive supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unsafe or misunderstood practice and explain a useful correction.

ambition.what: No larger supervision group or autonomous observation is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual supervision record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course views can reduce instruction lookup while direct laboratory and field supervision remain human.

assumptions: Representative supervised session with an actual required observation entry. Course staff produce existing instructions and records during ordinary work; focal reading remains in s1. No recurring course setup is charged to every session.

s2-s3 count actual observation and guidance; no automated competence, emotion, safety or grade inference occurs. s4 separately counts actual required writing and checking after practice. If no entry is required, remove it and re-estimate rather than inventing a report.

No clean observation feed or free transcription is assumed. Missing instructions or uncertain conditions require actual human investigation. Native functionality comes first; an existing course view gives no new gain.

This episode does not issue a laboratory permit, perform an experiment for the student, release grades or send a formal notice. Actual additional actions require their real work and authority if included. Ordinary save is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 10*0.20=2; upkeep 1 leaves net 1. Retained s1-s4 labour is 97 already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible effort and is fully retained.
research_questions: Observe a real supervised laboratory or field session and identify actual post-practice record requirements.

already_counted.description: Instruction reading, actual observation and guidance, and required observation writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain course views beyond ordinary supervision preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound reduces repeated instruction navigation only. If the course view already supplies this context, no new reduction or configuration upkeep is incurred. Direct supervision and actual record writing remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Read actual student and curriculum context using native student and course filters
Advise the actual student on academic and vocational curricula and career issues, explore needs and explain uncertainty
outputs: Actual advising discussion and clarified options

steps.what: Write and check the actual required advising entry, reusing exact verified course references
inputs: Actual advising discussion and unresolved questions

steps.what: Save the advising entry in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native student and course views in {LMS} and verified references in {DOCS}. Keep actual advising human and separately write any required entry, reusing only exact course references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student context and course references are repeatedly located and copied around real advising work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and reference reuse can reduce handling without recommending a career automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Student goals, constraints and uncertain career choices require human discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Help the actual student weigh options without promising outcomes.

ambition.what: No automatic academic decision or greater advising caseload is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual advising record permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student views and exact course-reference reuse can assist advising records while student counselling remains human.

assumptions: Representative advising episode with an actual required advising entry. Institutional staff produce existing student and course records in ordinary work; focal reading and verification are counted in s1. No recurring scheduling setup is charged to every meeting.

s2 counts actual need clarification, discussion and human understanding. s3 separately counts real writing and checking; only exact references verified in s1 are reused. No free transcript or structured student-goal feed is assumed.
Native features come first; existing views and links give no new gain. If no actual entry is required, remove it and measure real capture rather than inventing a post-conversation report.

No registration, admission, course change, placement commitment or external written recommendation is hidden in the advice or save. Real formal actions need actual authority and distinct steps. Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15*0.20+14*0.10=4.4; upkeep 1 leaves net 3.4. Retained s1-s3 labour is 94.6 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Existing course and student context views
research_questions: Observe a real advising session and distinguish live discussion, source lookup and any required written entry.

already_counted.description: Student context reading, actual advising and required entry writing and checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain advising views and reference reuse beyond existing entry checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs actual context navigation and course-reference copying. If native views already provide s1 context, only 1.4 copying points remain eligible; 1 upkeep leaves 0.4. Live advising remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Students producing actual work and clarifying real goals
Student registry staff handling actual transfer exceptions
Course staff maintaining current requirements and instructions
skills_to_grow: Direct field supervision and responsive advising
role.ambitious_version: An environmental-science teacher who spends less effort on repeated fields and transfers while retaining assessment, scientific learning design, supervision and student relationships.
